create_s2t_conformer_model: create a speech-to-text conformer model from an S2TConformerConfig using the factory function
create_conformer_encoder: build a conformer encoder with stacked ConformerBlock layers and lazy relative positional encoding
create_encoder_self_attention: create a multihead self-attention module with optional relative positional SDPA for the encoder
create_decoder_layer: build a standard transformer decoder layer with self-attention, cross-attention, and feed-forward sublayers
create_final_projection: create a linear projection layer mapping model dimensions to target vocabulary size
